title: Fix three bugs in a Rust statistics calculator
description: A statistics module has three bugs: mean divides by wrong value, median returns middle index incorrectly for even-length slices, and variance uses population formula instead of sample.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix one bug in src/lib.rs:
1. `variance`: change `sum_sq / data.len() as f64` to `sum_sq / (data.len() - 1) as f64` (sample variance uses N-1 denominator)
All 5 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test --quiet` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
